name: Tricep Rope Pushdown with Flare
description: A rope pushdown where the hands flare outward at the bottom of the movement to maximize tricep contraction. The flare at lockout adds extra peak tension compared to a standard rope pushdown. This technique is widely used for tricep detail work.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Tricep Rope Pushdown with Flare in the appropriate position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare equipment and body position for Tricep Rope Pushdown with Flare.
steps: Step 1: Attach rope to high pulley. Stand with elbows at sides.
Step 2: Push rope down toward thighs extending elbows.
Step 3: At the bottom, actively spread rope ends outward in a flare.
Step 4: Hold the flared position briefly then return with control.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale during the exertion phase, inhale during the return.
safety_considerations: Keep joints aligned throughout the movement.
Use controlled weight appropriate for skill level.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Move through full range of motion without compromising joint integrity.
